introduction.title: Ecclesiastes — book introduction
introduction.summary: Ecclesiastes reflects on work, pleasure, wisdom, injustice, time and death. Hevel evokes breath or vapor and life’s transience. The book calls readers to receive daily gifts gratefully and revere God.
introduction.authorship: The speaker is Qoheleth, or Teacher; the precise historical identity and date are debated.
introduction.setting: The reflections examine work, wealth, injustice, relationships, aging and mortality.
introduction.audience_and_purpose: Ecclesiastes reflects on work, pleasure, wisdom, injustice, time and death. Hevel evokes breath or vapor and life’s transience. The book calls readers to receive daily gifts gratefully and revere God.

structure.heading: Introduction and orientation
structure.summary: The book establishes its central questions and literary voice.

structure.heading: Exploration and instruction
structure.summary: Dialogues, prayers or sayings develop the central themes.

structure.heading: Conclusion and response
structure.summary: The closing material gathers the book’s challenge and invites faithful response.

interpretive_care: Hevel has a range of meanings; do not reduce it to one gloss.
The conclusion calls for reverence and accountability, not nihilism.

inductive_studies.title: The search for meaning
observation: Observe repeated words and the Teacher’s conclusion.
interpretation: What limits are placed on human achievement?
application: Reflect on a pursuit that cannot provide ultimate meaning.

inductive_studies.title: Seasons and time
interpretation: How are human action and divine sovereignty held together?

inductive_studies.title: Remember the Creator
observation: Observe the call to remember and the conclusion.
interpretation: How does the ending frame the book’s questions?
application: Name a daily way to remember God.

quiz.prompt: What Hebrew term is often translated vanity or meaningless?
quiz.explanation: Hevel evokes breath, vapor and transience.

quiz.prompt: Ecclesiastes tells readers to ignore God.
quiz.explanation: Its conclusion calls readers to revere God.

quiz.prompt: According to Ecclesiastes 3, there is a time for what?
quiz.explanation: The poem names times for many human experiences.
Ecclesiastes 12:1 calls readers to remember their Creator.

quiz.prompt: The Teacher’s identity and the book’s date are universally agreed.

introduction.title: መክብብ — መግቢያ
introduction.summary: መክብብ ስለ ሥራ፣ ደስታ፣ ጥበብ፣ ኢፍትሐዊነት፣ ጊዜና ሞት ያስተምራል። 'ሄቬል' ትንፋሽንና ጊዜያዊነትን ያስታውሳል። የዕለት ስጦታዎችን በምስጋና እንድንቀበልና ፈጣሪን እንድንፈራ ይጠራል።
introduction.authorship: ተናጋሪው ቆሄሌት ወይም መምህር ተብሎ ይጠራል። ትክክለኛ ታሪካዊ ማንነቱና የተጻፈበት ዘመን ውይይት ያለባቸው ናቸው።
introduction.setting: ሐሳቦቹ ስለ ሥራ፣ ሀብት፣ ኢፍትሐዊነት፣ ግንኙነት፣ እርጅናና ሞት ይመረምራሉ።
introduction.audience_and_purpose: መክብብ ስለ ሥራ፣ ደስታ፣ ጥበብ፣ ኢፍትሐዊነት፣ ጊዜና ሞት ያስተምራል። 'ሄቬል' ትንፋሽንና ጊዜያዊነትን ያስታውሳል። የዕለት ስጦታዎችን በምስጋና እንድንቀበልና ፈጣሪን እንድንፈራ ይጠራል።

structure.heading: ጥበብና መደምደሚያ
structure.summary: ፈጣሪን ማስታወስና መፍራት የመጨረሻው ጥሪ ነው።

interpretive_care: ሄቬል ትንፋሽን፣ ጭጋግንና ጊዜያዊነትን ሊያመለክት ይችላል።

inductive_studies.title: The search for meaning
interpretation: በሰው ስኬት ላይ ምን ወሰን ተቀምጧል?
application: የመጨረሻ ትርጉም ሊሰጥ የማይችል አንድ ፍለጋ አስቡ።

inductive_studies.title: Seasons and time
interpretation: የሰው ተግባርና የእግዚአብሔር ሥልጣን እንዴት ይቀራረባሉ?

inductive_studies.title: Remember the Creator
application: በዕለት ሕይወት ፈጣሪን ለማስታወስ አንድ መንገድ ጥቀሱ።

quiz.explanation: ግጥሙ ለብዙ የሕይወት ሁኔታዎች ጊዜ እንዳለ ይገልጻል።

quiz.prompt: የመክብብ ደራሲና የተጻፈበት ዘመን ላይ ሁሉም ተስማምተዋል።
